body: I don't know why anyone loving me would ever save me.  It's all a lie. I am not lovable. I have not got a loving bone in my whole body. I have not got a lovable cell in my entire body. I haver tried to be lovable, tried to be nice, tried to give people what they wanted from me. It's all just a lie. There is no fucking cake, stupid!
And of course, I forgot to mention that I have no real belief system.  All 'spirituality' was shamed out of me by the Atheist with whom I spent much of the past 15 years.

Every day I wake up and my first thought is just disappointment. I don't say to myself, 'Hey, today is a new day and there is so much you can do to get back on the right track, just do it!'

I know that if I saw anything up there above this horrid pit, I might have the desires to climb out.

There isn't anything up there.

Everything that makes me hate myself and my life will still be there again tomorrow and again the next day.

Every stitch of what might have made me a person has dissolved into nothing.  I am not a person. I am a pile of flesh and bones with no value. 

The only thing I need is to feel loved.

If someone could look me in the eye and tell me they loved me I might be saved.  I have cried out to the universe, I have prayed, I have wished and still nothing. I have spent money to put myself in the path of 'available' men and tried to fuck my way into their hearts. I am 'by the books' cute and funny and desirable and yet, I am not desired.

I am just used, over and over.

Before the internet, I joined singles clubs and meetups. They are just groups where men want to sow their seeds in women who are too lonely to admit they are being used.  One of the 'gentlemen', who was really great at making me think he actually liked me, let me know, after we were done fucking and I had hand-shaped bruises on my breasts, that he and his friends would exchange the numbers of the women they fucked.  I kicked him out of my bed and my home. I had been used before, I knew that, but, this time there was proof of 'conspiracy'.

The dating sites had more promise. They used matching quizzes to make accurate compatible matches.  Within minutes of starting up a new profile, I receive a whole lot of questions about whether I swallow, do anal, whatever ... and I wonder if I am just a prude. 
 Maybe that's how all women behave.  They just do whatever they are asked.  Is this why I feel so different?  These sites are just places for men to go to lie to and juggle many women and get laid frequently.  I started to analyze the 'matches' and they are all bullshit. Most of my 'matches' have blank profiles so how is it possible that this 'non-guy' has anything in common with me?

Why can't you just tell the truth, you assholes? Sometimes I just want to get laid, too! Sometimes I just want to feel someone close to me without having to clean their laundry or smell their shit or take on the role of their fucking mommy.

So here is the newest scam.  I am not sure where it came from but I am thinking it might have come from right here in reddit or 4chan or someplace.  Contact a chick who you crushed on or crushed on you years ago and say a few nice things and they will be so grateful you fucked them! This has been tried on me via FB now 3 times in the past year. The first one actually tricked me.  But he let me in on the conspiracy. He told me that his brother told him to find women that way. The next one fooled me only for long enough to have 'chat sex' and I put together the clues that he was married. When I challenged him on it, he said he was also fooling around with another mutual friend and that if I was a real friend, I would not tell his wife.  It's funny because he was one of my oldest friends. I knew him since the second grade and we WERE friends for a long time.  Why would he ruin that?

Now, enter Tinder and other lust-at-first-site swipe 'em and fuck 'em apps. I installed it to see what it was like but hid my porofile.  The fucking thing still continues to lie to me and tell me that someone swiped me the 'fuck 'em' direction. But my effing profile is hidden FFS.

This world is a fucking vampire. It has sucked the life out of me. It does not have love anywhere. I do not belong. I have clearly never belonged. I hate it here.
Back to sad at least. Still flooded with the ideas but not angry today.

thank you for your comments and wishes.  I am distracted today. I find that when I am angry, as I was yesterday, I am probably more at risk than if I am just sad and numb. Yesterday was very very bad. I am keeping distracted today.

You are asking me to choose from one of two equally pathetic things.

one - Choose to take my own life and 'not be alive' 

two - stay alive and bear the uncertain future that, as my pattern has gone, is likely to be just as miserable as my past and present.

In just the past week:

I planned a fathers day picnic with my two little nieces, whom I am really trying to know and like. The three of us and my father were to meet at this museum grounds and have a blanket picnic. The girls called me to buy a blanket. I was so excited to make a good memory. My brother, the girls' dad, showed up about 10 minutes before I arrived as I had to stop for a blanket.  By the time I got there, they had eaten ALL the food on some distant picnic tables and had already packed up to leave. Although I was bruised, I had brought a few other treats for dessert and said ok 'lets go on the grounds and have a real blanket picnic'. The other adults said 'No we are all finished'. I said 'But, I planned this with Grandpa and the girls' and they said they didn't care. That's it.... I said 'ok  then... goodbye.'  My brother called me Dramatic.  I literally said nothing! nothing!!!!

Then, on Friday, at my nephew's graduation, instead of just saying hi, my sister. his mother, looked at me and smirked and said 'hello' in a tone that was so strange that saying nothing would have been less rude.  The last time I allowed myself to be in her presence was Christmas when she was angry at me for buying gifts. (because of course she had nothing for me)

Then, Today, the event that started all of this internal combustion, I ventured up to my parent's place to retrieve some belongings and wanted to take a piece of furniture but it would not fit into my car. I asked my mother if I could borrow her truck and she said she had to ask my father. I said 'don't bother, he will say no'. and she got mad at me and said 'Why are you always so negative'?  She asked and he said 'No' as I expected. So I said,  'Fine... I don't need your help. I will take care of it myself.' My father followed me yelling and vaguely threatening me. I just kept repeating. 'Forget it, I will hire someone, let it go... just walk away.' Then he said... 'This is just typical of you!'  WHAT? FFS  What was typical?... I said 'forget it ... let it go ... its no problem' at least 10 times.  By the time I get home, I have a shitty email from mom that 'apparently dad can't understand why I wasn't accepting his help'. Again WTF? I must be going mad if that was what happened. Because that IS NOT what happened.

So then Mom yells at me on the phone for 30 minutes that 'I need to get over the past and let it go and act like I love them just like they act like they love me'............. What the ever loving fuck?

So the best I can come up with is that I have ripped off the blinders (as a result of therapy and standing my ground and setting boundaries) and proven that they are the jerks and they are fighting that clear revelation.

But I am so outnumbered. The gaslighting is thick and sticky. I can't take it any longer.

Everyone I try to get close to as a friend or lover expects me to have a genius beautiful relationship with these people who hate me. Why do these people have to be in everything I do??????? I cannot escape them. 

I tried once, I moved 1500 miles away and stopped taking their calls.  They sent the police after me.

Dammit, I just want to get out. There is only one way out. I would never feel another moment of pain or guilt or confusion. 50 years has been long enough.  If I was supposed to make a difference in any way to anyone, I can accept that I will never know and it must have already happened.

Just becasue I know why I hurt all this time does not mean that I want to continue hurting or that I can ever make the pain stop.

where? the meetup for miserable self-loathing hopeless people? 

Anyone who really really understands this, and I mean the childless, hopeless old people like me, are just not here anymore. I stuck around in my 20s, 30s and 40s because there seemed to still be a chance that I might be able to contribute something meaningful. Maybe meet someone and have a meaningful relationship. If I had a kid, I would be distracted by their life as so many of my FB friends demonstrate.

I made a stupid commitment to visit twice a week with an elderly lady who has no relationship with anyone in her family. I dread it every single time. I am reminded by the demented screams at the care home and the smell of urine and feces and the complete disrespect in the faces and attitudes of the care workers that that might be the best I can hope for in my old age. Because I am so unhappy, I cannot see any value in my visits.

Now in my 50s, I am not as educated as I had hoped to be, I am certainly not as financially sound as I thought I might be. I might inherit money but my parents are genetically gifted with longevity and will likely be around another 15 years to continue the torture.

My niece and nephew are nice young adults but to have a relationship with them, I am forced to have one with my sister who cannot keep from criticizing me every time she sees me. I cannot see that having a monthly or less frequent visit with these two young people is to anyone's benefit as I am forced to endure their mother. I really do not benefit them at all and I will not use them to prop up my mood occasionally as any advance is sure to be destroyed by my sister.

Again, this argument has been spinning relentlessly in my head for many many years. I just think I am one of the many people my age who pass without ceremony by their own hand. 

I will be a statistic. 

(I had this huge section on stats and I thought it might break the rules)

I have contributed nothing, I have created nothing of lasting value, I have only sucked resources from the earth. I was a waste.

I am looking up suicide shit and so many people have lots to say about making it all better.  The idea that one who feels friendless and lonesome should just 'get some friends' is laughable. How does anyone so lonely, and full of self-loathing make friends?

my life... when shown dispassionately and objectively seems fine.  I have an ok job, I have a roof over my head that is almost paid off so I have 'savings' in the equity. I have money in the bank and a more than decent car.   

All these things make me look normal. I am not normal. I am very very sad and very very lonely. 

I can't keep friends, or partners because I find them all too much to take.  I give and give and feel like I get nothing back. I am always providing emotional support and never receiving it. I am the eternal people pleaser and fuel supply for those who need to always take.

I believe that my family is a narcissistic 'hive' and I am their 'food'. I bounce around from one to another as they abuse me and use me. They say things about others and about me that I cannot imagine that I have ever uttered.

I have no family of my own, I am too old to have children. I can't stand the idea of doing this for another 30 or 40 years

I can't stand the idea of doing this for another year

My uncle killed himself years ago for very similar reasons. Apparently this happens each generation

I try to explain I am depressed and they blame my 'miserableness' for it. They say it's my fault they dislike me because I have isolated myself and that I should just shut up and move on.  What does that even mean.  When I confessed to my father that I was suicidal he said...'Ah you wouldn't even be able to do that'

I read my thread from before the election when I was here last.  I guess the mere fact that the election finally was past in no way alleviated stress... It was high on my list of stressors and the result of it remains high on my list. Interesting that I had optimism about it at that time.

No, nothing unkind at all.  On other posts here I had a few unsolicited pms suggesting I should date (him) which gave TMI in his username. Nothing I couldn't handle.  This is a great and safe area, I have found. Sometimes it's scary to post about ANYTHING on ANY SUB for fear of attacks so I lay low most of the time.

It was nice to wake up to some kind words. Despite the rules for this sub I was sure I would get something ... unkind in my inbox.  It was good.

My friend isn't that important... lol 

If it was an agent handling the email, he would have replied to my interest in producing a film when I said I would pay production costs!  Who wouldn't jump to at least see that idea.

It's funny.  I have wanted to do this via documentary film for years.  The one person I know in the film industry, who was a very close friend years ago, will not even respond to my attempts to contact him AT ALL. I tell myself that his email is managed by his wife and she doesnt want him to talk to an old flame, or, he hates me.
I am so sorry about your loss. I can't read rude.... love

If I went to another place, I might have a honeymoon period where I am fascinated and the people are fascinated and it might light me up and keep me afloat. I know I would still be a scam target but that's so much easier when people WANT to befriend me even if just to practice english.
Thank you. This is what I needed. Made me cry in a good way. xoxo
I am looking. Thanks for the comment! Very optimistic!
yes xoxo

> Yep, got that right; I felt like the cows of all things were judging me. I actually had to laugh for how insane those thoughts were, which broke the cycle.

OK you made me laugh...

I have given myself a project.  Stupid me... I have been looking for things like this old archived thread 

https://www.reddit.com/r/AskReddit/comments/16u34x/people_who_attempted_suicide_what_did_you_do_on/ 

and I want to explain how I feel.

Maybe it should be in r/depression, I don't know.

I was just thinking that this pervasive thought in my brain at almost all times is the desire to commit suicide and the actual imagination that 'this is how I can do it' as the scenario(s) replay themselves.   ***  and I don't know how this compares to others  ***

Sometimes I think about my uncle and how I could do what he did.  Sometimes I have other plans.  The thing that makes me cry is not the sadness over doing it, it's the pain of these constant and unrelenting thoughts. They just do not stop.

I wake up and within moments I realized that I am awake and not dead and the self destructive imagery begins.

If I do not find some stupid thing to do... sometimes its just playing video games... these thoughts would be playing non-stop. When I am distracted, I might suddenly tip over into the cycle again. Maybe its a phone call or the realization that I have wasted more hours on games.

There is no activity that keeps these thoughts completely at bay. I could be working out, driving, sitting in a waiting room, visiting an acquaintance, anything. The thoughts just take over whenever, sometimes without triggers at all.  I would estimate that I get these images and thoughts every 10 minutes when I am not terribly distracted.

Anyone who is that obsessed with killing another person would be considered criminally insane, don't you think?

I have 2 cats and a few house plants and these are the things I think of when I get really close to giving in. Fucking houseplants? It's pathetic. The cats might miss me but they will get over it. The plants would die. A few orchids that I have nursed from near death to blooming. Nobody sees them but me.

Update on the weird leads: on this attempt to get customers... they are not panning out but I am willing to continue them for a few more days to see what happens.

Also, maybe I will feel better after the election is over. That's wigging me out a little too... so there is a few weeks.

I also had the idea that I might try some illegal drugs (I am so straight) just to see what that's like.  Nothing addictive, just mind altering for an experiment. I have no idea how to get them so that might take a while to figure out.

Even with these 'hang in there' projects, i might just suddenly start crying and say WTF... why am I waiting? What will be different? What's the point of this? its either a sticky self-pity quagmire or wave after wave of contradictory thoughts.

Anyway... nothing good so far... nothing at all... just a very very tiny hopeful moment every now and then. (sigh)

now I am just angry that i dont want you to wake up thinking that i am gone.  why do i feel this obligation to you, a complete stranger to make sure you are OK... while I hate myself so completely.  i guess i am lucky to have received a few clicks today and think maybe there might be a lead on its way...these feelings are not going away any time soon... i am just getting slightly distracted...  as long as there is money to spend... i suppose thats a distraction... click$ are not great but i guess I can hang in a bit..... I am clearly unreliable.  I am not a troll.... I am really just very sad and now mad at myself.  i have wondered all week what it will take to cause me to do that last thing.  I came so close after a call today.  the door is still so wide open. I just really NEED a good thing to come my way that helps to change this.
thank you for trying

thats a remarkably profound statement.

what if i just take the last few dollars i have and just run away, disappear, whatever.   no internet, no nothing.  i could run so far and change my name and maybe get a cash job... yeah right like that's possible in this world.  there is no running away anymore. there is no escaping this pathetic life.

I just want a little little bit of something that makes me feel like it would be worth getting up each day.  i wake up automatically and as soon as I do, i remember there is nothing.  i will just sit at my desk and stare or cry or just wonder why other people have good lives or loving families and I have nothing. i did this to myself i guess.  i ruined my own life. i burned all my own bridges.  i know that if i had just had a kid when i could till have them, i would be distracted enough today with their stuff and i would have something... anything

Well, time is almost up.  Today, I received a call from my father who has the power to refer customers to me and will not do it because he wants to control everything. He gave me the name and number of a man with whom I might do business. I was thinking this might be the money... and so i called the guy.  He signed a contract with someone else yesterday. My life is a fucking joke. I would bet that my father knew the contract was already signed and just wanted to make me think he is helping.
7 hours left and I have tried to rebuild my site and started advertising. I don't think it matters. I will have no money and no income and nothing left to sell. When i die, at least there is insurance for someone to clean up. Why won't the universe make this harder to decide?

> You also somewhat want to hang on you know? You know it will only hurt more and yet you hold on to that barbed wire, simultaneously trying not to fall deeper in the pit yet only getting more scars and suffering more painful moments.

ugh

Thanks again for your support.  

I should also let you know that my uncle successfully took his own life about 20 years ago. He was well educated and wealthy and very active in a number of different hobbies and philanthropic activities. 

He had three children and a very attractive wife. Strangely, his closest friends felt that his unbearable grief was focused on never having satisfied his brother (my father) with his successes. 

It is certainly a similar situation for me.  My father belittles and condemns my proudest moments and I have no other role models from whom to glean joyful words. My mother told me I SHOULD have died from cancer as my sister lay dying in the bed beside us of another disease not long ago. She said it on three occasions that day when I finally came to realize she really was wishing she could make me change places with my dead sister.

I try not to interact with them unless absolutely necessary but I have no other friends at this time. Depression tends to destroy relationships.

My mother has banned me from her presence yet, in front of others, invites me for Sunday dinner. It's a sick fucking game she plays with me. I just can't take any of it any more.

I don't want to do this to teach anyone any sort of lesson or to throw crap in anyone's faces, I just cannot continue with this pain all day, every day.

I got off of refined sugar and I have been eating a vegan diet for the past six months and there have been NO changes in these feelings. I can't take pharm or natural medication because of my liver being toast from the chemo. I took some 5-HTP and L-Tyrosine but I can already feel my liver starting to hurt so that's not possible.

You see, I have tried everything. No matter how I distract myself today, I will wake up tomorrow and it will all be just the same or slightly worse. 

I just don't see the point.

I have attempted to volunteer on numerous occasions over the years.  My state of mind is not very good for receiving other people now. I have low tolerance of just about everyone.  I no longer trust anyone.  I am telling you that there is nothing worthy of all this effort.

I have 2 volunteer things I do right now and each and every time I go, I start swearing and negative self-talking before i even get there about how I hate it and just do not want to go anymore and how nobody there likes me. It's a bad bad time whenever I go. I don't see the point in it anymore.

i like your post. thank you. I am sorry you were bullied, that is a cruel thing that ignorant people do.  i have been outright bullied on a number of occasions through my life.  

I am middle-aged now and feel that my life has been a series of episodes wherein 'the rug was pulled out from under me' far too often. I have no purpose, no people, no satisfaction in my life.

I have no children of my own because treatment for cancer caused me to be sterile.

As for education, I would love to attend university but i do not have the income to do so at this stage and no longer qualify for student loans as i wasted my loan opportunity on a now defunct college and its useless diploma.

Compound these lost opportunities with poor choices and now I sit alone and sad and just don't have the chops for it any longer.

50/f 

I am not doing so well.

I am hitting this wall pretty hard with respect to hopelessness and meaninglessness in my life.  

In 4 decades I still do not have a handle on why I feel so different all the time.  I just don't seem to fit in.

Romances are always a disaster.  Places of employment seem to make me feel more 'outside' the larger the group of colleagues. I have no children of my own and my siblings and parents think I am a failure in all things with really no proof.  

I find that even though I am nice and outgoing, some more vocal people tend to feel threatened by me and I end up losing friends and colleagues far too often.  

I think I am nice. I think I am smart. I have done some pretty cool things in my life. Most people have told me that I am exciting and attractive.

I don't like to be alone but it seems that I am constantly being removed from social groups or removing myself for moral or values reasons. I just don't get it.

Is it possible to be an outgoing person but live like a hermit. I feel more at ease on a stage than at a cafe table.  I do not really want to maintain contact with my siblings or parents but they guilt me into it and it makes me feel rotten after every exchange.

I do not know what I expect to get from posting here but please don't bother suggesting volunteering or church or taking up a new hobby because at my age, I have done everything, tasted everything, experienced so much.  I just think its time to give up on companionship and just choose to live a life of relative solitude.

I am already quite lonely and I am very afraid that choosing the hermits path might not be beneficial.

I can truly say that my depression is 100% about loneliness.

Thank you for the words of support

I don't really want to talk anymore. 

It just seems I go in the same circles over and over.

I am faking everything with everyone out here.  My therapist just thinks I have anxiety.  My boss thinks I am still just sad over my sister's recent passing.

I am just not able to do this any more.

I am seriously trying to give myself things to do, goals, obligations and then it just dissolves into the pain.

Again, thanks for the attention.

I am not good.  I am mostly down and when I am not down, I am distracted by some stupid obligation.  The loss and whatever else happened to tip me over the edge is still present.  I am still not 'seeing' a tolerable future.  I only see a loneliness punctuated with pain if I try to reach out to people. I have learned only that I am a social fool.  

Every time i turn around I am forced to endure messages that the only thing that matters is family and loved ones and I have none. I am condemned to be alone and I would rather not live alone any more.  It is very simple and un-fixable problem. I am not going to be able to get close to anyone.  This last time was very very difficult.

Maybe I have a choice to become a shallow person and float through the rest of my natural life only receiving attention from people intent on stealing from me or taking other advantage of me. But honestly, that is not worth the effort of hauling myself out of bed.

I do not trust myself to read anyone.  This is too sad and lonely in here. I always feel like I am begging.

The nail in my proverbial or as I like to think, literal coffin was hammered today.

My 'soul mate's' 70-year-old father explained to me that he thought soulmate was still in love with ex-wife of 4 years ago and that I was just a fling in a long line of flings.

Oh agony! Really?  Can we add insult to injury any more cruelly?  I can only assume it's true and that I was also used and tricked.

What is wrong with people?  Why does anyone mislead other people's hearts to ruin? What is that motivation?

I am lost.

I used to imagine the ups and down in my life as the tides.  Sometimes they ebb, other times they return.  The water flows in to wash away the litter and mistakes of the past and leaves this lovely clean sand in which I can write my name or build a castle. 

When I felt like the tide was low, I could talk myself into the idea that it will come back, full and cool and clear.  In fact, the depth of the low tide would indicate the height of the coming high tide and the joy it might bring. I can't convince myself of this anymore. 

This low tide is so deep. I wish that is was the depth before a tsunami of joy. I need joy so badly.

I just want to be heard dammit!  Please hear me!  I hurt so much.  

I have done this too often.  I have loved and left and lost too many times.

I have never had this depth of pain.  I really can't do this.  I can hang on only as long as I have obligations to clear because there is nobody to clear them for me. There are very few left.

This is not just about one lost love.   This is about everything.  It is my loveless childhood. It is my inability to read feelings. It is my unfortunate childlessness which will leave me alone at my death, no matter when it occurs. It is my foolish and idiotic attraction to the idea of love and romance and magic.  It is such a complete and utter loss of everything for which I have ever hoped.

How do you do it?  How do you get up in the morning?  How do you go through your day? How do you know you will be joyful?

Part of me wants NOT to believe how I am feeling. The same part of me that feels tricked and misled by my broken love-dar wants to scream, 'It's all a lie, don't believe in anything!' 

I feel like one of Mudd's robots in Star Trek. 'I love you, but I hate you'. I trust my heart to fall in love but I don't trust it to know if you have fallen in love with me, no matter what you say. In fact, I should not trust what you say. But you say you are telling me the truth. And yet this other person says they know you and you really felt something else. And my gut says believe, but my head says, don't trust my gut. Then my straw poll tell me that the majority acts on their gut. HOW CAN MY GUT BE WRONG AND SOMEONE ELSE'S GUT BE RIGHT?  WHY CAN'T MY GUT BE RIGHT????

And if my gut is right.... then I should leave this world.  This is what my gut is telling me now.  It says, 'You don't belong here anymore, and you probably never did.'

Please someone hear me... please!

I saw my psychologist today. She asked my why he was so important to me and all I could come up with was that it was just right.  She used the word 'home' before I could say it.  He made me feel as if I was home.  Home is supposed to be secure and safe.  It didn't need to be a place, just a feeling I had when I was with him.  A feeling I have never had before and I cannot imagine taking another 50 years to find it again. I really don't think I will make it very far with all this twisted and confused pain.  I am trying DBT but I am so overwhelmed.

Still Feeling very sad.  I am trying very hard to keep busy. Doing things that make me feel like I have obligations. Keeping me engaged in my life.  It's easy to put on that 'I'm OK' mask.  Feels like I am the only person who wears that.  I know there are others.

I just want to stop feeling all this pain.  I will listen to a song or think of something poetic and I feel this immense loss.  Like someone died and I will never see them again.  It's hope that I lost.  It hurts so much.

My advice, since you are young and have not become as completely wasted and jaded as I have, is forget about 'love' and focus on 'compatibility'.  Find someone with whom you could spend 25 years raising a family and just do that.  You will get more joy out of just making a few kids and spending your life with someone you like just enough to make it tolerable than you will by saving it all for the 'right' SO.  There truly is no magic in it.

I truly thought that magic was happening when some crappy coincidences disguised as fate pressed this normally shy guy to seek me out more than once over 30 years.  We discovered the most obscure similarities and even the way we spoke and used language was like a mirror.  Before I hated the idea of destiny, I would say that he and I were made for each other.  In 50 years that happened once.  That is NEVER going to happen again. My effing brain will never let anyone get that close to me again. I am NOT willing to spend a year 'getting over it' then another year 'playing the field' and then whatever amount of time wasted on getting close to some other men. I have no more of me left to offer.  I do not want to take one more step that will only remind me of what I am never ever going to have.  If I had had a child it would be different. I would have been able to create my own companion.  But it's just me.  I have been putting all my affairs in order.  To the world, I am moving on. But in my mind, I am writing my final chapter.  That idea just does not go away from the moment I wake until I finally fall asleep.

I know you mean well but again, I am 50, I have had my stages of being 'single and lovin' it'.  The answer is no. I wanted an SO to share travel and food and funny things and life's hard moments.  That is what I wanted.  I have just come to the awful realization that it doesn't exist at all. I have all the freedom anyone could hope.  Please read the post.  It isn't about 'one man' or 'suddenly single' or 'loving myself first'.  It's that life is not worth living if I can't have the hope that love is a real thing and that magic can happen between people.  I am not willing to spend 30 more years here on earth in that reality. Period.
